meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计优质前端界面，整合品牌与性能标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要构建美观且高性能的前端界面
copy.tagline_en: Design high-quality frontend UI with brand and performance standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build beautiful and high-performance frontend UI

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 做前端相关工作时会先创建或读取 DESIGN.md,再按需加载风格与品牌参考来写页面和组件;涉及性能时用真实浏览器跑 Lighthouse,最后做视觉对比。产出包括设计系统文档、组件和审计报告。
howto.when: 当你说到「前端」「UI/UX」「设计」等关键词,或要求做页面样式、重设计、性能审计等前端工作时,该技能会触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个页面重设计一下,参考 Linear 的风格。
say.note: 会加载 Linear 品牌参考,按它的规范产出新设计。

say.text: 给这个 React 项目做一次性能审计,目标 100。
say.note: 会用真实浏览器跑审计并按结构问题修复。

say.text: 把这个 Figma 稿转成代码,先建好设计系统。
say.note: 会先提取设计令牌到 DESIGN.md,再实现组件。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude creates or reads DESIGN.md first, loads style/brand refs, then builds UI. Performance uses real-browser Lighthouse; ends with visual QA. Output: design docs, components, audit reports.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like 'frontend', 'UI/UX', 'design', or ask for page styling, redesign, performance audits, etc.

say_en.text: Redesign this page referencing Linear's style.
say_en.note: It loads Linear's brand reference and produces a new design.

say_en.text: Run a performance audit on this React project, target 100.
say_en.note: It audits in a real browser and fixes root causes.

say_en.text: Turn this Figma mockup into code, set up a design system first.
say_en.note: It extracts design tokens into DESIGN.md before coding.
